scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Real coefficients; finite simple cactus graphs; same-signed bidirected edges; fixed-vertex inherited-sign filtrations; degrees zero and one only. General signed-short-cycle relation credited to foundational prior work. All unbounded claims have explicit proofs; finite checks corroborate but do not prove them. An equivalent unindexed treatment is possible. No independent validation.
title: Signed-cactus GLMY homology: persistent ranks and exact automorphism characters
